scripts.test:ui: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format allure-cucumberjs/reporter --format-options '{"resultsDir":"allure-results"}'
scripts.test:api: npx cucumber-js tests/features/APIFeature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format allure-cucumberjs/reporter --format-options '{"resultsDir":"allure-results"}'
scripts.test:performance: npx cucumber-js tests/features/performance --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format allure-cucumberjs/reporter --format-options '{"resultsDir":"allure-results"}'
scripts.test:login: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/login.feature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress
scripts.test:inventory: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/inventory_*.feature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --format allure-cucumberjs/reporter --format-options '{"resultsDir":"allure-results"}'
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run report:generate
scripts.report:clean: npx rimraf allure-results allure-report || rm -rf allure-results allure-report
scripts.report:generate: npx allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && echo 'Allure report generated at allure-report/index.html'
scripts.debug: npx cucumber-js tests/features/UIFeature/login.feature --require tests/steps --require Setup/hooks.js --format progress --dry-run
